name: European Seabass (Spigola / Branzino)
habitat: Shallow rocky shores, harbor mouths, surf zones
bestBait: Live prawns, live mullet, 120mm minnow plugs
description: Sleek silver ambush predator of the Mediterranean. Thrives in white water created by Mistral winds along rocky shores. Focus fishing during dawn/dusk Solunar transitions.

name: Gilthead Seabream (Orata)
habitat: Sandy bays, Posidonia seagrass, shellfish beds
bestBait: Live beach crabs, bibi worms, fresh mussels
description: Famous for the golden bar between its eyes and crushing jaws. Highly cautious bottom feeder. Best targeted on Full Moon nights using crab baits on fine fluorocarbon leaders.

name: Greater Amberjack (Ricciola)
bestBait: Live squid, live garfish, 150g–250g vertical jigs
description: The ultimate power predator of Mediterranean deep reefs. Hunts in packs near capes and seamounts. Solunar Major Overhead periods trigger ferocious surface & mid-water strikes.

name: Common Dentex (Dentice)
bestBait: Live octopus, live squid, slow pitch jigs
description: The 'King of the Mediterranean Reef'. Recognizable by its metallic blue/pink body and sharp canine teeth. Striking with immense force, it requires heavy tackle and instant hooksets.
